body.alt: A young man holding a nadaswaram wind instrument with a flared bell beside another man cradling a round thavil barrel drum laced with yellow cords

hero.subject: the octagonal timber Istana Kenangan royal palace at Kuala Kangsar, Perak, with woven-bamboo kelarai walls and gilded carved trim
hero.alt: An ornate octagonal timber Malay palace with steep tiered shingle roofs, walls of diamond-patterned woven bamboo in black, white and gold, latticed windows and a gilded carved frieze, set on a lawn under an overcast sky

body.subject: a traditional timber Malay stilt house (rumah Melayu) with a steep gable roof, carved fascia boards and a raised verandah reached by wooden steps
body.alt: A dark-brown timber kampung house raised on wooden stilts, with a steep gable roof, carved scalloped eaves, panelled wooden walls and an external staircase leading up to a verandah, framed by green foliage

body.subject: the Negeri Sembilan timber palace Istana Ampang Tinggi with sweeping upswept Minangkabau buffalo-horn gable roofs
body.alt: A long raised timber Malay palace with sweeping upswept Minangkabau-style roofs curving to sharp points, panelled dark-wood walls with latticed windows, standing on carved posts beside a signboard reading Rumah Negeri Sembilan

hero.subject: a Malaysian family in matching pale-yellow traditional dress for Hari Raya in Kuala Lumpur, the man in baju Melayu and the two women in baju kurung
hero.alt: A smiling Malay family of three posing on a house porch at Hari Raya in coordinated pale-yellow outfits, the man in a baju Melayu tunic and trousers flanked by two women wearing baju kurung and headscarves

body.subject: rows of Malay men in colourful baju Melayu and black songkok at a royal wedding prayer gathering in Selangor, Malaysia
body.alt: A large gathering of seated Malay men reading from Qurans, each wearing a baju Melayu in a different colour and a black velvet songkok cap, filling a mosque hall with red carpet

body.subject: a man modelling a complete men's baju Melayu outfit, a royal-blue tunic worn with a black songkok and a songket samping, on a white studio background
body.alt: A man standing against a white background wearing a royal-blue baju Melayu with a mandarin collar, a black velvet songkok and a glossy blue floral songket wrap (samping) folded over the trousers

hero.subject: Orang Ulu musician in traditional dress playing a carved sape boat-lute, Sarawak, Malaysia
hero.alt: A tattooed Orang Ulu musician in a feathered hat and beaded costume plays a large sape lute painted with bold red and black Bornean spiral motifs

body.subject: Row of large rebana ubi frame drums from Kelantan, Malaysia
body.alt: A row of large rebana ubi drums on blue wooden stands, their bodies and frames painted with vivid floral patterns in red, green, yellow and pink

body.subject: Elder musician playing the serunai double-reed pipe at his home in Kelantan, Malaysia
body.alt: An elder man in an orange shirt plays a serunai double-reed wind pipe, with rows of Malay frame drums lined up on the floor behind him

hero.subject: the red Dutch Stadthuys and clock tower on the historic square of Melaka, part of the George Town and Melaka UNESCO World Heritage Site
hero.alt: The deep terracotta-red Dutch Stadthuys building and its square clock tower in Melaka, ringed by a planted roundabout of red and green foliage, with directional signposts in the foreground under a bright overcast sky

body.subject: Lebuh Armenian (Armenian Street) in the George Town heritage quarter of Penang, part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site
body.alt: A narrow heritage street in George Town, Penang, lined with old two-storey shophouses hung with red lanterns and a Batik Painting Museum signboard, a blue Lebuh Armenian street sign on the right and a quiet road with a yellow pedestrian crossing

body.subject: Mount Kinabalu rising above Kinabalu Park in Sabah, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
body.alt: The grey granite massif of Mount Kinabalu in Sabah, its jagged ridgeline rising above forested foothills, with leafy green trees and a grassy slope in the foreground under a clear blue sky

hero.subject: Row of Kelantan-Patani style Wayang Kulit leather puppets silhouetted against the backlit screen during a shadow-play performance
hero.alt: Intricately cut leather shadow puppets lined up and glowing against a bright lamp-lit screen, in the Kelantan-Patani Malay wayang kulit style

body.subject: Close-up of a vividly painted Kelantan Wayang Kulit leather puppet on its control rod, Kelantan State Museum, Malaysia
body.alt: Close-up of an ornately carved and brightly painted leather wayang kulit puppet in orange, green and purple, mounted on a thin bamboo rod

body.subject: Kelantan Wayang Kulit puppets and gamelan drums displayed in a thatched hut setting with an explanatory panel, Kelantan State Museum, Malaysia
body.alt: Two colourful leather shadow puppets standing in front of traditional drums and an information board inside a woven-bamboo hut display

hero.subject: a framed Malay wooden panel pierce-carved with flowing awan larat foliage motifs, Malay Peninsula, 19th-20th century
hero.alt: A dark, framed rectangular wooden panel carved in openwork with symmetrical flowing foliage, curling leaf tendrils and vine scrolls in the Malay awan larat style, mounted on a pale museum wall

body.subject: the gilded, intricately carved timber minbar (pulpit) of the Tengkera (Tranquerah) Mosque in Melaka, Malaysia
body.alt: An ornate timber mosque minbar with a tall gilded canopy carved and pierced with gold foliage and a crested finial, rising above a red-and-gold carved staircase on a green prayer carpet

body.subject: a carved fretwork eaves board (papan kerawang) trimming the roofline of a traditional Malay timber house in Hulu Langat, Selangor
body.alt: A band of pierced fretwork carving in flame-like foliate shapes running along the timber eaves board beneath the roof of a brown-planked traditional Malay house, framed by green foliage and sky
